conclusions.text: The authorized task scope contains 230 Atlas subjects, 17 parent references and three area contexts. These are evidence workload counts, not geographic approval.

The 2024 Greek Ministry report describes municipalities as first-level and regions as second-level local authorities; it reports 332 municipalities and 13 regions. These national facts do not provide an exact crosswalk or boundary for any scoped record.

Constitution Article 105 describes Mount Athos as a self-governed part of Greece with administration through representatives of twenty Holy Monasteries; the text does not settle exact feature geometry.
ELSTAT lists dated 2011 and 2021 census/cartographic products. Those products do not establish current legal municipality boundaries or complete island/settlement coverage.
Kew describes WGSRPD Level 3 as botanical countries that may ignore political boundaries. The inherited area labels do not establish sovereign territory or certify exact Atlas polygons.

The 2010 Greece and 2021 Kosovo source products provide historical lineage context only. Current legal roster and feature-level boundary mappings, island/city completeness, source rights compatibility and several parent relationships remain unresolved.
Neighboring North Macedonia roster/geometry vintages are a limited granularity context; no cross-border legal parent, current boundary or completeness finding is made.
